text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait a sec... I went all out today,
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I don't really feel tired at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm in peak condition right now!
That
means I can do more training!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do some solo practice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do some solo practice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To the training track at full speed!
Ready, set,
BLAST OFF!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Winning Ticket for some
supplementary
training.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh... I didn't even think of that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I save my energy, I can be at even
fuller power
later! Thanks, Trainer! I'd
never have noticed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To better prepare for future training
sessions,
Winning Ticket agrees to rest
for today.
